label: Cap census complement extension
title: Does the corrected radius bound hold where the cap census disagreed with its complement?
kind: Exact census extension on 22 cells at R ≤ 6
summary: On every cell where the R ≤ 2 census gave different pass/fail for a rule and its complement-conjugate, a cap exists on both sides by radius 3, the post-hoc bound holds, and the observed radius shift is 1 or 2, never more than h+1.
takeaway: The first audit's failed prediction was a budget artifact: complement conjugation moves cap radius by at most two here and never removes a cap. The radius budget is part of the representation contract.
